scope: TRAIN-only noise-aware selection between the existing linear and quadratic physical carrier fits; no supervised residual correction, new physical case draws, neural training, policy change or reserved designs
inputs: Pin the existing48 critical-only128-sample measured windows and archived linear/curved results before scoring; preserve leading51 calibration, float32/cap50, physical frequency bounds and all original accuracy gates
selection: Waveform-only curvature signal-to-noise. Reconstruct the profiled constant-channel-coefficient residual at the curved optimum. Compute its six-parameter dimensionless central-difference Jacobian, per-channel residual variances with shared nuisance degrees of freedom, and heteroscedastic sandwich covariance. Retain curvature only when the joint two-curvature Wald statistic exceeds2*log(channels*samples); otherwise choose the measured linear fit. No physical references, noise labels, design, velocity or margin enter selection.
numerics: Centered difference step=cbrt(machine epsilon)*max(1,abs(parameter)); require full six-column Jacobian rank and positive curvature covariance. Residual variance floor is machine-epsilon-squared times channel mean-square signal, not a tuned noise floor. Record unavailable curvature evidence and failed fits explicitly; a valid linear candidate remains an explicit model choice, not an invented estimate.
threshold: Fixed BIC-scale complexity penalty for two extra parameters; no threshold/strength search on these repeatedly inspected designs. This is an approximate model-selection statistic, NOT calibrated confidence or a true heteroscedastic maximum-likelihood BIC.
assumptions: Approximately independent residual samples with channel-specific variances. Leading-prefix calibration and unmodeled physical response can violate these assumptions; physical scoring, not the statistic, determines qualification. Correlated noise remains a later required stress evaluation.
hypotheses: Unsupported curvature fitting noise causes stationary degradation: rejecting unsupported curvature should restore the frozen noisy-stationary guardrail
Real within-window pole curvature is observable above noise: the selection should retain useful ramp recovery rather than revert wholesale to the linear baseline
Transport/coupling is not corrected by order selection: quantitative native failures can persist even if noise guardrails recover
controls: All48 native measured views and all48 oracle frozen-carrier views; oracle controls diagnose mechanism only and never become deployable inputs. Reuse archived fits instead of refitting old failures for reassurance; separately exercise the complete fitter on known waveforms and pinned native windows.
qualification: All six original critical-stage checks unchanged. Report case recovery, signs, interior/failure counts, clean/noisy stationary error and ramp MAE versus both archived comparators. Ordinary mixtures remain gated on all critical checks; this correction does not qualify headroom or warnings.
progress: Current-stage progress=100*passed original critical checks/6, equal weight, failures or missing evidence receive0. Report pole recovery separately; score may fall. Overall endpoint progress=100*fully demonstrated research gates/10 from P4_RESEARCH_TARGET.md; development controls cannot qualify blind end-to-end gates. Percentages measure criteria attainment, not effort, confidence, safety or publication probability. Freeze denominator; version any future criterion changes explicitly.
limitations: Unmodeled transport can contaminate residual variance estimates
No ordinary-mixture, structural headroom, warning or real-time qualification
